data.title: Unit 9: Electricity and Magnetism
Electricity
data.rubric: First click on the objects that require attention. Next, click on the correct option for each question.

question1.text: Electrons orbit around the middle of the atom.

question2.text: Electricity is of two types: current and electric.

question3.text: The type of electricity in which electrons flow in the same direction is called static electricity.

question4.text: Electricity produced when two objects are rubbed together is called current electricity.

question5.text: Electricity travels at the same speed as the speed of sound.
